title: Workflow
description: Envelope schema for a manage_workflow upsert. Structural gate only: per-step `arguments` are validated against each tool's own input_schema, and step/input references by services/validation.rs. Self-contained (remote $ref resolution is disabled).

name.description: Unique slug; the name the workflow is run by. Upsert key.

description.description: Blank or null means none (the HBI sends null for an empty field).

every.description: Schedule period (30m, 6h, 1d, 1w). Absent keeps the current schedule; null removes it (runs by name only).

inputs.description: Declared inputs; steps read them as {{inputs.<name>}}.

checks.description: Opt-in: evaluator scores the result; critic reviews the plan before it runs.

default.description: Make this the workflow a Task with no named workflow runs.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.

topic.description: The topics/*.yaml topic this schedule works on; blank or null = spans topics. Checked against the declared topics.

kind.description: What sort of work it is.

next_run_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant of the next dispatch. Defaults to now on create.

managed_by.description: yaml = force-synced from workflows/<name>.yaml every startup; runtime = graph-owned, the seeder never touches it.

steps.description: ChainStep array, run in order as one job chain.

tool_name.description: Must name a registered tool (enforced live against the tool registry, not this schema).

arguments.description: Tool arguments. Validated against the named tool's own input_schema at the write boundary.

provider_hint.description: Top-level, sibling of tool_name/arguments. `ollama` = local; omission routes to cloud. Inside arguments it is silently ignored by routing.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.

id.description: Names this step so a later one reads its output as {{steps.<id>}}.

optional.description: A failed optional step does not cancel the rest of the run.

topic.description: A declared topic; absent or null for none.

needs.description: The data this step wants (API_USE_PLAN Phase 1), so a registered API can be matched to it. A label only: it does not change how the step runs. Kind and topic are checked against the closed lists on save.
